doc.name: agent-bev Library
doc.instructions: agent-bev Library: The trade rulebook for beverage alcohol, country by country, each section with its official sources. Call list_countries, then get_rulebook with a country's code. Read-only. Every answer carries the notice line and audience: trade.

tools.name: get_rulebook
tools.description: The trade rulebook for one country by its two-letter code (uk for the United Kingdom): market status, who can trade, customs and duty, labelling, age and sale limits, protected names, GTIN authority, and open items and as-of date; each section lists its official sources, and a part with no official source says "Not yet sourced".

code.description: two-letter country code as the Library writes it, for example es, uk, jp

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Every country in the Library with its code, its page and its as-of date.
